one_liner: The Meadow app lets creators customize sky background, HDR lighting, sun direction, intensity, color, and fog settings in a Hyperfy world.
primary_use_case: Provides a UI for configuring environmental lighting and atmospheric effects (sky texture, HDRI, sun angle, intensity, color, fog) in a Hyperfy scene.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided fallback PNG preview; it reliably represents the sky setup, though a live preview would better showcase dynamic lighting.
